quotes: if the applicant has a name with multiple parts, you must determine how the name will appear:
P0000.rationale: The proposed condition targets C0017 along with C0018, C0019, and C0020. However, C0017 already incorporates this exact conditional clause directly into its baseline definition and scope ('if the applicant has a name with multiple parts, you must determine how the name will appear:'). Conditioning C0017 on an external copy of its own antecedent is inappropriate and fails to establish a valid target baseline. Furthermore, C0018, C0019, and C0020 already fully incorporate this multi-part name condition within their scope definitions, so the addition does not fix a real defect or support every target.
